summary: Frontend-only verification of the redesigned (1) Transaction History page and (2) Withdraw page on https://evoque-payout-fix.preview.emergentagent.com at 430x900 (mobile) and 1440x900 (desktop), in both light and dark theme. All 8 review-request scenarios PASSED. No live DB mutations (submit button stays disabled as expected). One environment note: the documented test user 08099887766/newpwd did NOT exist in the backing Mongo (only admin + one unrelated 'King Manny' user) — I had to re-register 08099887766/newpwd via POST /api/auth/register (with security questions pet/Rex, mother/Smith) before login could succeed. The fresh user has ₦1,000 welcome bonus, no bank, no PIN, no investments — which is exactly the unmet-requirements state the review asks us to verify.
action_items: (env hygiene) The 'live production DB' the review-request referred to has been replaced with a fresh DB in this preview container — the documented test users (08099887766, 08011112222) no longer exist. Either re-seed those users or update /app/memory/test_credentials.md so the next testing agent doesn't burn cycles diagnosing 401s. I already re-registered 08099887766/newpwd (sec Q: pet/Rex, mother/Smith) so subsequent iterations can log in directly.
critical_code_review_comments: History.jsx is clean: Money-in/Money-out useMemo correctly splits credits vs debits, groups useMemo preserves API newest-first ordering by inserting into a Map keyed by formatDate(t.created_at). Loading skeleton renders 3 placeholder groups with .animate-pulse (verified visible during filter switch). Empty state and grouped feed are mutually exclusive. No <table> anywhere in the file — confirmed via DOM query (tables inside [data-testid=history-root] === 0).

Withdraw.jsx 'withdraw-requirements' IIFE correctly omits the PIN step when settings.require_withdrawal_pin !== true (verified: no-pin-banner/set-pin-link absent for this test user because admin has not enabled PIN requirement). The card hides itself only when allStepsDone && windowState.open (line 123) — matches spec. progress bar width = (completed/total)*100, transitions smoothly. Completed steps render a 'Done' pill instead of the action button. withdrawals-closed-banner only renders when bankReady && !windowState.open (currently absent because window is always-open, which the spec explicitly allows).
Submit button stays disabled = true (verified) because !bankReady || investmentsCount === 0; tooltip 'Add complete bank details first' matches button label fallback — good UX.

Minor a11y/console: pre-existing Radix warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' from the welcome modal still fires (carried over from iteration 16, not regressed by this iteration).

success_rate.frontend: 100% — all 8 review scenarios verified on mobile + desktop, light + dark

test_credentials: phone 08099887766 / password newpwd (re-registered this iteration; wallet ₦1,000 welcome bonus, no bank/pin/investments, sec Q: pet=Rex, mother=Smith)
seed_data_creation: Re-registered test user 08099887766/newpwd via POST /api/auth/register because the previous user record was missing from the current Mongo. No other seed data created. No deposits/withdrawals/invests submitted.

rca of the issue: No bugs found in the redesign. The only friction was an environment-data mismatch: the documented test users were missing from Mongo, producing 401s on /api/auth/login. Reproduction: curl POST /api/auth/login with the documented creds returns {detail:'Invalid phone or password'}. Mitigation: registered 08099887766/newpwd via /api/auth/register; subsequent login succeeded with HTTP 200 and full E2E UI verification proceeded normally. Both redesigned pages render exactly as specified — History as a date-grouped feed with Money-in/out summary tiles (no table), Withdraw as a single 'Unlock withdrawals' checklist with progress bar (no border-l-4 amber cards), navigation pill buttons route to /profile and /invest correctly, submit stays disabled, theme/responsive/overflow all clean.
